Text: This is your home. Place cards on the tiles that connect to your home to Grow.
TO WIN: surround opponent’s home tile, or have more tiles on the board when the Draw pile runs out.
Every turn has 3 steps – Draw, Grow and Throw. You start by drawing 1 card from the top of the Draw pile or the Throw pile.
Grow: drag one of your cards from your hand onto the board, or tap it to select and then place it on the board.
Throw: swipe up, drag it to the Throw pile, or double tap to Throw a card. This ends your turn.
Tiles keep the rank of the card used. Higher ranks are harder to cut.
The Draw pile is empty – this is your last turn.
They Draw, Grow and Throw too.
You had more points – you won!

When it appears: After your first draw: before you strengthen
Text: Strengthen: a stronger card can replace your own tile.

When it appears: Your second turn: right before you take their tile
Text: Cut: a higher card can take an opponent’s tile.

Nothing can Grow on a rock.

When it appears: After your first draw: before you Grow onto the gold
Text: A gold tile counts double, so it is worth two points.

When it appears: After the draw: right before you cut
Text: Cut a tile to break the chain behind it.
Tiles cut off from their home disappear.
You had more points – you won!

When it appears: After your first draw: before you Bloom
Text: BLOOM: three cards with the same number, or three in order in one suit.
Bloom grows several tiles at once and does NOT use your Grow.
You had more points – you won!

When it appears: After your first draw: before you surround
Text: Surround: fill every tile around their home for an instant win.

When it appears: After your first draw: before you Bomb
Text: Bomb: removes one enemy tile, even a 9. Uses your Grow.

When it appears: After your first draw: before you Blast
Text: Blast: two Bombs clear a large area. Homes are safe.

When it appears: After the Blast: before your Grow
Text: Blast clears several tiles at once and does NOT use your Grow.
